title: Note: reading a ghost story, part 2
summary: The story continues: a time statement, a verb that carries something back, and a quiet realization.

blocks.text: This episode carries on with the same ghost story and works through the next few sentences. It is a reading practice rather than a new grammar topic.

items: A sentence often opens with a time statement, such as "after the party ended", that sets the scene. In relaxed speech the particle after it may be dropped.
One verb can be chained to 来る: 忘れてくる means to leave something behind and then come away without it.
A long phrase can be packed into a noun with こと, and a verb such as 気づく (to notice) then uses it as its content.
Small words like ふと (suddenly, by chance) set the mood.

blocks.text: The aim is a habit: read a long sentence from the engine backwards, and ask for each piece which word it modifies.
